moral.zh: 再大的困难，也可以从眼前的一小步开始。只要方向正确、大家齐心并坚持下去，就能慢慢带来改变。
moral.en: Even the biggest challenge can begin with one small step. With a good plan, teamwork, and persistence, change can grow little by little.

idiomMeaning.zh: 比喻不怕困难、坚持不懈，努力克服看似不可能的阻碍。
idiomMeaning.en: Literally “Yu Gong moves the mountains”; it describes facing a great difficulty with steady, determined effort.

pages.zh: 从前，太行、王屋两座大山挡在愚公家门前。老人每次出门，都要绕很远的路。
pages.en: Long ago, the great Taihang and Wangwu Mountains blocked the road outside Yu Gong’s home. Every trip meant a long detour.

pages.zh: 愚公对家人说：“我们每天搬一点，把山前的路慢慢打开吧！”家人都愿意一起帮忙。
pages.en: “Let us move a little each day and slowly open a road,” Yu Gong told his family. Everyone agreed to help.

pages.zh: 第二天，全家来到山脚。大人松土搬石，孩子只提轻轻的小篮子，大家做得又稳又慢。
pages.en: The next day, the family began at the foot of the mountain. The adults loosened soil and moved stones while the child carried only a light little basket.

pages.zh: 一天又一天，他们一筐一筐地运走泥土和小石头，山脚渐渐露出一条窄窄的小路。
pages.en: Day after day, they carried away basket after basket of earth and small stones. A narrow path slowly appeared at the mountain’s foot.

pages.zh: 邻村的智叟见了，摇头问：“山这么大，你一辈子怎么搬得完呢？”
pages.en: A doubtful old neighbor saw them and asked, “The mountains are so large. How could you finish in one lifetime?”

pages.zh: 愚公笑着说：“我老了，还有儿孙；山却不会再长高。只要不停，总会前进。”
pages.en: Yu Gong smiled. “After me, my children and grandchildren can continue, but the mountains will not grow. If we keep going, we will make progress.”

pages.zh: 他们坚定的心感动了天帝。天帝派来两位大力神，稳稳地把两座山移到了远方。
pages.en: Their steadfast hearts moved the Heavenly Ruler, who sent two mighty helpers to carry the mountains safely far away.

pages.zh: 从此，家门前有了平坦的路。人们用“愚公移山”赞美不怕困难、坚持到底的精神。
pages.en: At last, a clear road stretched beyond their home. “Yu Gong moves the mountains” came to honor courage and persistence in the face of difficulty.
